shortDescription: Manage OpenVPN client certificates using EasyRSA.

options.name: clients
options.description: List of OpenVPN client definitions. Each client entry controls whether a certificate should be present or absent.

options.name: force
options.description: Recreate an existing client certificate when set to C(true). The module revokes the existing certificate, regenerates the CRL, removes local client artifacts, and then creates a new certificate.

options.name: working_dir
options.description: EasyRSA working directory. All EasyRSA commands are executed from this directory.
